# Colecto v0.9.0

Smoother animations and pane switching, safer AI keys, and sturdier mail sync.

## Smoother app

- Dragging tabs between panes and resizing panes no longer stutter. A drag updates
  once per frame, and the layout is saved when you let go instead of on every move.
- Background mail sync no longer rebuilds the whole message list on every tick. Only
  the status line at the bottom of the list updates.
- Screens slide in from the first frame instead of showing in place for a moment, and
  menus open where they belong instead of jumping into place.
- A few small changes in how things look: the Settings section list collapses straight
  away, the new-label field keeps a fixed width, and on Android the predictive-back card
  shows its rounded edge from the start of the gesture.

## AI keys

- Changing the text or decision model's base URL in **Settings → AI** removes the saved
  API key, so a key is never sent to a server it wasn't saved for. The page says so
  under both fields. Saving or clearing a key needs an unlocked vault. See
  [AI](https://github.com/kogical/colecto/blob/v0.9.0/docs/ai.md).

## Mail

- A message that fails to parse no longer stops a folder from refreshing. The rest of
  the folder still loads.
- An inbox named `inbox` or `Inbox` on the server is recognized as the Inbox.
- You can remove a label from a message that isn't in the loaded part of the list.
- JMAP: mail you send is marked as read in Sent, and some text parts that were dropped
  before now show.
- In the desktop app, non-Latin text arriving over the live update stream no longer
  turns into garbled characters when it is split across chunks.

## For extension authors

- A bus request answered by an extension's client part no longer fails with
  `429 Extensions busy` while mail is syncing in the background.
- Client parts keep their slot state when the parent re-renders, and reconnect their
  events and slots after a Worker restart.
- Extension packages with forged sizes are rejected before they are unpacked.
